story.fullStory:
Ac/dc's "Back In Black" reached #37 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Back in Black" is a song by Australian rock band AC/DC.

It was released as the second US single from their seventh album, also named Back in Black, and released in 1980 through Atlantic Records.

Notable for its opening guitar riff, the song was written as a tribute to the band's former singer Bon Scott, who died suddenly in February 1980.

The song peaked at #37 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.
